articles.summary: 新修订的《云南省安全生产条例》将于11月1日起施行，并大幅提高违法惩戒力度。条例明确，对重大、特别重大生产安全事故负有责任的企业主要负责人终身不得担任本行业生产经营单位主要负责人，同时保障从业人员拒绝违章指挥和强令冒险作业的权利。条例还明确平台经济、低空经济等新兴行业的安全监管责任，对了解地方安全生产监管和责任追究变化具有参考价值。

articles.title: Love with nowhere to go
articles.highlight: 悲伤并不只属于逝者；当我们无法正视其他深刻的失去时，我们便成了自己的陌生人。
articles.summary: 这篇 Aeon 文章由 Derek van Zoonen 撰写，主张悲伤体验不只发生在有人去世时：项目失败、关系破裂、身份转变等深刻失去同样需要被承认和哀悼。作者指出，如果缺少描述这类失去的语言，人们会把情绪压回自身，最终与自己变得疏远。值得一读的是，它提供了一个理解日常"无声失去"的视角，也提醒我们语言与仪式在情绪安放中的作用。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：承认失去并为其命名本身就有价值，缺乏这种承认时，情绪会转化为自我疏离；这对管理者理解团队挫败感同样适用。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Grief is not only for the dead. When we are unable to honour other profound losses, we become strangers to ourselves - by Derek van Zoonen Read on Aeon

en.highlight: Grief is not only for the dead. When we are unable to honour other profound losses, we become strangers to ourselves.

articles.failureAnalysis: 部署时，任务感知投影器混合可能依赖明确的任务标识或分布假设，遇到未见任务、设备差异和临床场景漂移时存在性能下降风险。统一多模态接口也可能放大信号噪声或对齐误差，需在真实脑机接口与临床环境中验证鲁棒性和安全性。所给文本未包含实验细节，因此不能据此判断其跨任务泛化与临床可用性。
articles.sourceExcerpt: IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON MULTIMEDIA 1 OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding Jiacheng Zhang, Xueyi Zhang, Xin Lu, Siqi Cai, Haizhou Li Abstract—Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive- state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding.

en.title: OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding
en.highlight: EEG is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces and cognitive-state analysis, yet modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms.
en.summary: OneEEG is a unified signal-visual multimodal language model for multi-task EEG understanding that uses a task-aware mixture of projectors. The authors note that EEG supports clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces and cognitive-state analysis, but its modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. The work aims to offer a multimodal large-language-model interface for cross-task EEG analysis.
en.failureAnalysis: In deployment, the task-aware mixture of projectors may rely on explicit task identifiers or distributional assumptions, creating performance risk for unseen tasks, device differences and clinical domain shift. The unified multimodal interface may also amplify signal noise or alignment errors, so robustness and safety need validation in real brain-computer interface and clinical settings. The supplied text lacks experimental detail, so cross-task generalization and clinical readiness cannot be judged from it.

articles.title: trhhubsd/ARTEX
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该 GitHub 项目展示了一个名为 ARTEX 的 AI 自主渗透测试系统，采用多智能体 LLM，并以 Go 和 Next.js 实现。项目已有 2057 stars，且描述称其获得百度 agent+ 攻防挑战赛冠军，说明其在 AI 安全自动化方向受到一定关注。对非技术决策者而言，值得观察的是它如何把 LLM 多智能体能力落实到真实攻防流程，而不仅仅停留在演示。
articles.failureAnalysis: 自主渗透测试直接涉及授权、合规与攻击面控制；如果缺少严格的权限边界、审计和沙箱，企业很难在生产环境中采用。真实攻防环境复杂，结果又需要可复现；多智能体 LLM 可能带来误报、漏报、成本与延迟问题，因此工程验证门槛较高。2057 stars 和比赛冠军能证明关注度与 Demo 能力，但不能替代对付费需求、部署成本和长期维护的验证。

en.highlight: ARTEX is an AI autonomous penetration testing system built with multi-agent LLMs, Go, and Next.js, and its description says it won the Baidu agent+ offense-defense challenge.
en.summary: This GitHub repository presents ARTEX, an AI autonomous penetration testing system using multi-agent LLMs and implemented with Go and Next.js. It has 2,057 stars and claims a championship in Baidu's agent+ offense-defense challenge, making it worth watching as an example of LLM agents applied to security automation.
en.failureAnalysis: Autonomous penetration testing faces strict authorization, compliance, auditability, and sandboxing requirements, while LLM agents can introduce false positives, missed findings, latency, and cost issues in complex real-world environments. Stars and a competition win validate attention and demo capability, not production demand or deployment economics.
